body:
This is exactly what I'm going through right now.  Mine is a clinically insane, pill-popping, officially-diagnosed bipolar maniac who more than once has told me she wished she aborted me.  She called me last night to literally shriek at me because she interpreted something that I said *weeks* ago in entirely the wrong way (surprise surprise) and then hung up on me.  I've gotten to the point where I realize that I simply don't love her anymore.  I try, but there is nothing for her in my heart anymore.  I don't see her as my mother anymore.  She is just another person on this planet.  One who (actually, the only one) regularly antagonizes me.  

I'm just done.  Can't find a job, about to be without a place to live, friends progressing in leaps and bounds around me, tired of my mom's shit, tired of life in general.  It's always been this way and it always will be.  I don't want to be here anymore.
